name: BenchECG
description: BenchECG is a standardized benchmark comprising a comprehensive suite of publicly available ECG datasets and versatile tasks designed to evaluate foundation models for ECGs, enabling rigorous comparison and accelerating progress in ECG representation learning.
reputation: A promising standardized ECG benchmark for foundation models, but it is very new and not yet broadly established in the community.
notes: Includes multiple publicly available ECG datasets and tasks; introduces xECG model as baseline.
